mapper.sql: SELECT pos.pos_id AS job_id, pos.pos_title AS job_title, pos.pos_department AS job_category, pos.pos_company_id AS company_id, pos.pos_publisher_id AS publisher_id, cmp.cmp_name AS company_name, cmp.cmp_logo_url AS company_logo_url, cmp.cmp_industry AS company_industry, cmp.cmp_size AS company_size, cmp.cmp_city AS company_city, cmp.cmp_address AS company_address, cmp.cmp_intro AS company_intro, cmp.cmp_detail_json AS company_details, pos.pos_work_city AS work_city, pos.pos_salary_min AS salary_min, pos.pos_salary_max AS salary_max, pos.pos_experience_required AS experience_required, pos.pos_education_required AS education_required, pos.pos_job_type AS job_type, pos.pos_jd_json AS jd_json, ( SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(psk.psk_name ORDER BY psk.psk_required DESC, psk.psk_id SEPARATOR ',') FROM t_pos_skill psk WHERE psk.psk_position_id = pos.pos_id ) AS skill_names, pos.pos_status AS status_code, pos.pos_created_at AS published_at, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_app_record app INNER JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = app.app_candidate_id WHERE tal.tal_user_id = #{userId} AND app.app_position_id = pos.pos_id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS applied_flag, ( SELECT app.app_id FROM t_app_record app INNER JOIN t_tal tal ON tal.tal_id = app.app_candidate_id WHERE tal.tal_user_id = #{userId} AND app.app_position_id = pos.pos_id ORDER BY app.app_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS application_id, ( SELECT tal.tal_matched_score FROM t_tal tal WHERE tal.tal_user_id = #{userId} AND tal.tal_company_id = pos.pos_company_id ORDER BY tal.tal_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS match_score FROM t_pos pos INNER JOIN t_cmp cmp ON cmp.cmp_id = pos.pos_company_id
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT pos.pos_department FROM t_pos pos INNER JOIN t_cmp cmp ON cmp.cmp_id = pos.pos_company_id WHERE pos.pos_status = 1 AND cmp.cmp_status = 1 AND pos.pos_department IS NOT NULL AND pos.pos_department != '' ORDER BY pos.pos_department
